        ### Question
        Regarding the administration of drugs subcutaneously, which of the following statements is correct ?:

        ### Options
        opa. The incorporation of vasoconstrictors, such as adrenaline, increases the speed of absorption.
opb. It is a parenteral route of difficult access.
opc. When drugs are administered in this way repeatedly, for example insulin in type I diabetics, it is recommended not to alternate the injection site to avoid the appearance of lipodystrophies.
opd. Solid forms of sustained release can be implanted to obtain extended periods of release of some drugs.

### Reasoning Chains per Option:
CHAIN: Subcutaneous drug administration -> slower absorption compared to intravenous route -> due to the need to pass through the skin and subcutaneous tissue -> 80% CHAIN: Vasoconstrictors like adrenaline -> can increase the speed of absorption when added to subcutaneously administered drugs -> by constricting blood vessels at the injection site -> 70% CHAIN: Subcutaneous drug administration -> suitable for drugs that require slow and sustained release -> as it allows for gradual absorption over time -> 85% CHAIN: Repeated subcutaneous injections at the same site -> can lead to the formation of lipodystrophies -> hence, it is recommended to alternate injection sites -> 90% CHAIN: Solid forms of sustained-release drugs -> can be implanted subcutaneously -> to achieve extended release periods -> 80%
